# Ultimate List of Marketing Automation Platforms for 2023

September 5, 2023 **\- By [Builderall Blog](https://thebuild.builderall.com/author/bablog/)**

\\”A majority of businesses use marketing automation tools nowadays — in fact, studies cite around 56% of businesses currently use the technology, and that number continues to grow.\\” – [HubSpot Blog](https://thebuild.builderall.com/%22https://blog.hubspot.com/marketing/marketing-automation-software-tools/%22). With the rapid advancement of technology and the ever-evolving landscape of digital marketing, businesses are constantly seeking ways to streamline their operations and improve their marketing strategies. One such method that has gained immense popularity is the use of marketing automation platforms. These platforms not only help businesses automate repetitive tasks but also provide valuable insights into customer behavior, leading to more personalized and effective marketing campaigns.

## **What is Marketing Automation?**

Definition and Significance:

Marketing automation refers to the use of software tools and technologies designed to automate repetitive marketing tasks. These tools allow businesses to nurture prospects with highly personalized, useful content that helps convert prospects to customers and turn customers into delighted, loyal brand advocates.

The significance of marketing automation lies in its ability to streamline, automate, and measure marketing tasks and workflows. This not only increases operational efficiency but also grows revenue faster. It\\’s like having a dedicated team working around the clock, but without the overhead costs.

Benefits of Automating Marketing Tasks:

*   **Efficiency:** Automation reduces the time and effort required to execute and manage marketing campaigns. This means businesses can run more campaigns simultaneously and see results faster.
*   **Personalization:** With automation, businesses can tailor content to individual user behavior. This means sending the right message to the right person at the right time, increasing the chances of conversion.
*   **Data Collection:** Automation tools often come with analytics that provides insights into customer behavior and campaign performance. This data is invaluable for refining marketing strategies.
*   **Lead Management:** Automation ensures that leads are nurtured consistently and passed on to sales when they are sales-ready, ensuring no lead is lost or overlooked.
*   **Scalability:** As a business grows, its marketing needs grow too. Automation platforms can easily scale to accommodate growing subscriber lists and more complex campaigns.

## **Features to Look for in a Marketing Automation Platform**

When diving into the vast sea of marketing automation platforms, it\\’s essential to know which features will truly make a difference for your business. Here\\’s a breakdown of the most crucial features:

**Lead Management and Scoring:** This feature allows businesses to track potential customers\\’ interactions with their brand, score them based on their likelihood to convert, and nurture them accordingly. A good platform will let you segment leads based on behavior, demographics, and more.

**Email Marketing Automation:** Beyond just sending out emails, this feature automates the entire email marketing process. This includes segmenting email lists, A/B testing, autoresponders, and tracking performance metrics like open rates and click-through rates.

**Social Media Automation:** Managing multiple social media accounts can be a daunting task. Automation tools can schedule posts, track mentions of your brand, and analyze the performance of your content across different platforms.

**Analytics and Reporting:** Data-driven decisions are the backbone of successful marketing. The platform should offer comprehensive analytics on user behavior, campaign performance, and ROI. Look for platforms that provide visual reports, making data interpretation easier.

**Landing Page and Form Builders:** Creating landing pages and forms that convert is crucial. Some platforms come with built-in builders that are intuitive and offer templates, making the creation process seamless.

**CRM Integration:** If you\\’re already using a Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system, ensure that the marketing automation platform integrates seamlessly with it. This ensures that sales and marketing teams are always on the same page.

**Mobile Optimization:** With the increasing number of mobile users, it\\’s essential that the platform offers mobile-optimized templates and features. This ensures that campaigns look and perform well, irrespective of the device used.

When choosing a marketing automation platform, it\\’s essential to prioritize features based on your business\\’s unique needs. While some businesses might prioritize email marketing, others might find more value in social media automation. Always opt for a platform that aligns with your marketing goals and strategies.

## **Comprehensive List of Marketing Automation Platforms**

In today\\’s digital age, there\\’s no shortage of marketing automation platforms available. Each offers a unique set of features tailored to different business needs. Here\\’s a curated list of some of the top platforms, along with a brief description of each:

**HubSpot:** A frontrunner in the marketing automation space, HubSpot offers an all-in-one solution, integrating CRM, email marketing, social media management, and analytics. Its user-friendly interface and extensive resources make it a favorite among both beginners and seasoned marketers.

**Marketo:** Acquired by Adobe, Marketo is a comprehensive solution tailored for medium to large businesses. It excels in lead management, email campaigns, and has robust analytics to measure campaign effectiveness.

**Pardot (by Salesforce):** Designed for B2B companies, Pardot offers advanced lead management and scoring. Its seamless integration with Salesforce CRM ensures that sales and marketing teams are always aligned.

# Best Marketing Automation Platforms: Find Your Match (Compare These 15 Options)

By

Daniela Ochoa

* * *

Published August 7, 2024

Updated October 19, 2026

Currently, the landscape of marketing technology spans a [whopping 9,932 solutions](https://chiefmartec.com/2022/05/marketing-technology-landscape-2022-search-9932-solutions-on-martechmap-com/) ranging from analytics to video platforms. It’s expanded 24 percent over recent years. And among the top hottest areas of growth? Marketing automation platforms, with 353 options currently captured in the category.

With so many of the best marketing automation platforms before you, it’s no surprise that decision paralysis can creep in. That’s why we’re here.

In this article, we remove 99.95% of the clutter (really) to bring you 18 of the best marketing automation tools on the market. Let’s dive in!

[Final Thoughts](https://www.thinkific.com/blog/marketing-automation-platforms/#Final-Thoughts)

## What is marketing automation software, anyway?

In 2019, the global marketing automation market was valued at around [USD 4 billion](https://www.grandviewresearch.com/industry-analysis/marketing-automation-software-market). In 2024, it’s valued at almost [USD 7 billion](https://thecmo.com/marketing-automation/marketing-automation-market-size/), with no signs of slowing down. 

Why the popularity? Well, these platforms just make life easier.

Basically, the best automated marketing platforms take care of key marketing tasks for you, well, automatically. They help you identify your audiences, deliver relevant content and measure the success of your campaigns and optimize your marketing strategy without a lot of human work behind the scenes. 

Those tasks can be as simple as sending an automatic thank-you email when someone makes a purchase, or as complex as analyzing customer behavior across several campaigns, segments and channels, and triggering personalized content through every [sales funnel stage.](https://www.thinkific.com/blog/sales-funnels/)

For example, you might use marketing automation to: 

*   Send emails, social messages and texts to people when they take action on your website
*   Align and schedule new content and social media posts across your channels
*   Target and retarget audiences for advertising campaigns
*   [Nurture leads through an email drip campaign](https://www.thinkific.com/blog/email-automation-sell-online-course/)
*   Identify the most promising opportunities for purchases, upsells or cross-sells
*   Measure and report on customer behavior and campaign effectiveness
*   Optimize messages, strategies and calls to action

## Is marketing automation worth the investment?

Ask marketers who use marketing automation platforms how important the technology is to the overall success of their digital marketing strategies, and [91 percent will tell you](https://www.invespcro.com/blog/marketing-automation/): very! Here’s why.

### Marketing automation platforms save time (and money).

Who has the time to send out individual welcome emails, never mind follow-ups and full email sequences? Who can afford to manually keep tabs on interested leads, walk them through your purchase experience and track their success?

Marketing automation platforms pick up the slack where you can’t. With the platform handling administration and delivery of your marketing campaigns, you and your employees can get back to adding value where it’s needed the most.

Take Michael Kiel for example. He co-founded and led an inbound marketing agency for 15 years before launching his own business, [Boat Planet](https://boatplanet.com/). He says, “there is no doubt that marketing automation is well worth the investment. In my past business endeavors, utilizing systems like HubSpot produced significant outcomes, such as a minimum 12% reduction in marketing overhead costs and a substantial increase in productivity.”

His experience is supported by market research too, with one estimate suggesting marketing automation platforms can help reduce marketing overhead costs by as much as [12.2 percent.](https://www.invespcro.com/blog/marketing-automation/)

### Marketing automation platforms boost conversion.

A platform that collects data about customer behavior across the purchase journey means you can more effectively figure out what they’re looking for, why they care and how to deliver relevant messaging that meets their needs, right when they need it.

In fact, [4 in 5 consumers](https://www.epsilon.com/us/about-us/pressroom/new-epsilon-research-indicates-80-of-consumers-are-more-likely-to-make-a-purchase-when-brands-offer-personalized-experiences) who receive personalized experiences say they’re more likely to make a purchase.
